specification_compliance: Touch-point departures TP-1 to TP-4 are present at this commit, as read from the working tree and compared with the pre-change test and doc copies in the main checkout.
The detected-move branch (scanner.py:657-679) matches spec section 1: only path columns change.
Spec section 2 says an OSError from os.replace keeps the pointer; the code does so at thumbnail.py:783-789. Spec section 1 does not state what a stat error other than not-found should do.
potential_unspecified_behavior: A stat failure other than not-found during migration is treated as an absent file (thumbnail.py:707-710), and the spec does not define this case.
A non-regular file at a pointer's path is also treated as absent (thumbnail.py:711-712), and the spec does not state this.
